title: hunter
tagline: Hunter is a special tool in the Powerloom system that works specifically with Uniswap, a decentralized exchange. Its job is to take snapshots, like pictures, of the current state of things.
description:
In a world where Forex thrives on currency fluctuations and constant activity, Hunter emerges as the equivalent for Uniswap aficionados. Just as Forex traders meticulously dissect market trends for profit, Hunter diligently captures real-time snapshots of Uniswap trades.

Much like the role of Forex platforms in currency trading, Hunter serves as a dynamic tool. It provides continuous monitoring, allowing users to delve into trade volumes, liquidity reserves, and various metrics. This empowers traders to make informed decisions in the ever-changing landscape of cryptocurrency trading, potentially unlocking profitable opportunities. Simply put, Hunter acts as the gateway to real-time tracking and insightful analysis, making the Uniswap market more navigable for traders.

how_its_made:
- Shifting from regular web development to using Powerloom was tricky.
- Learning about blockchain and Web3 tech was like climbing a steep hill.
- Figuring out what exactly to build with Powerloom was a bit confusing.
- Connecting the website and APIs had its tough moments because I wasn't sure about the steps.
- Luckily, the Powerloom team was super helpful in guiding me through the challenges.
- It was like putting puzzle pieces together – carefully figuring out what Powerloom can do.
- With their support, we made it work seamlessly in the end
